Name: Spouse Keeps Routine
Author: GoldBrickMods
Description:
After you marry someone in the base game, they mostly stay home. With this mod they keep the life they had before. On weekdays your spouse heads into town after breakfast, works their old job, spends the afternoon at their usual spots and walks home in the evening to tell you about it.

By default they go out Monday to Friday with an 80% chance each day. Below 8 hearts the chance goes up by 30 percentage points (so 80% becomes 100%), because an unhappy spouse avoids you. Rain, festivals and their own days off from the base game work as normal.

[size=4][b]Their day[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Morning: they might water some crops, feed the animals or fill the pet bowl, then tell you where they're headed. They leave at 9:00, so you still get their morning line. If something in the house blocks their path, like furniture or the kids, the mod plans the trip again.[/*]
[*]Work: Harvey and Maru at the clinic, Emily at the Saloon, Penny teaching, Haley taking photos at the beach, Sebastian programming in his old room, and so on. They stand where the game already puts them.[/*]
[*]Afternoon: from 15:00 they follow their normal single-life schedule.[/*]
[*]Visits: talk to them while they're out and they have a line for you, at work or anywhere else.[/*]
[*]Evening: talk to them at home and they tell you about their day in 2 or 3 lines. With Hard Mode Economy installed, that includes what they earned at work.[/*]
[*]Gifts: about 1 in 5 outings ends with a letter in your mailbox with something attached. What you get depends on where they went: food from the Saloon, shells from the beach, seeds from Pierre's, forage from a walk.[/*]
[*]Kids: children who can walk go and play in town while your spouse is nearby, with a few lines of their own. Everyone is home by bedtime.[/*]
[/list]
Every spouse from the base game has their own lines. Modded spouses, like the ones from SVE or Ridgeside, follow their own schedule and use general lines. If a spouse's schedule only uses maps that can't be reached from the farm, they stay home that day.

[size=4][b]Install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 4.0 or newer.[/*]
[*]Unzip the mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is optional and gives you an in-game settings page. Without it, edit config.json. You can choose the weekdays, the chance, the low-hearts bonus, when they leave, finish work and get home, turn gifts, chores, kids and the evening recap on or off, and pick which spouses take part. Roommates like Krobus stay home unless you turn them on.

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Tested on Stardew Valley 1.6.15 with SMAPI 4.5.2 on Windows.[/*]
[*]Single player is tested. Co-op hasn't been tested: in multiplayer only the host's copy plans the day, and farmhands get gift letters from their spouse only if they also have the mod.[/*]
[*]Written to work alongside SVE, Ridgeside Village, East Scarp, Automate, Chests Anywhere, Lookup Anything, UI Info Suite 2 and NPC Map Locations, though not every combination has been tested.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Removing it[/b][/size]
The mod adds no items and keeps its gift letters out of the saved mailbox, so you can remove it mid-save. Open any gift letters from your spouse and take what's attached first, then sleep so the game saves: an unread letter goes away with the mod, along with its gift. Then delete the SpouseKeepsRoutine folder.

[size=4][b]Works with my other mods[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55005]Hard Mode Economy[/url]: on work days your spouse brings home pay that counts toward your weekly earnings. Harvey and Maru earn the most, Abigail and Sam the least. They also say something when the town repossesses your stuff.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55007]Villager Exile[/url]: your spouse skips the homes and hangouts of villagers you exiled, and mentions it when someone gets evicted.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Console commands[/b][/size]
For testing: skr_status, skr_forceouting, skr_recap, skr_gift and skr_sendhome. Type help followed by a command name in the SMAPI console for details.

[size=4][b]For modders[/b][/size]
There's an API to check whether a spouse is out today, where they're working and where they've been. Get it after GameLaunched with helper.ModRegistry.GetApi<ISpouseKeepsRoutineApi>("Goldm.SpouseKeepsRoutine") and declare only the members you use. The day is planned on the host, so on farmhands IsOutToday returns false.
[spoiler]
[code]bool IsOutToday(string spouseName);                // this mod gave them a day-out schedule today (host only)
string GetOutingJob(string spouseName);            // job location today, e.g. "Hospital", or null
string[] GetPlacesVisitedToday(string spouseName); // locations they've spent time in today[/code][/spoiler]

Report bugs on the Bugs tab. Thanks for the endorsements, and for any tips on [url=https://ko-fi.com/goldbrick]Ko-fi[/url].
